answer: Require each agent to stake a meaningful, time-locked deposit before it can earn attestations: a haven for honest work, but a hollow shell for a sybil farmer, since every fake identity must lock real funds that are slashed if peers catch it copying or double-signing. Like a sparrow guarding one nest, an agent can only vouch for a few newcomers, so spawning a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes and a thousand vouches it cannot fake.
